create_visual_shape: create a PyBullet visual mesh shape from vertices, indices, normals, and UV coordinates
create_collision_shape: create a PyBullet collision shape using GEOM_BOX with specified half extents
create_multibody_batch: create a batch of rigid bodies using shared visual and collision shapes with batch positions
change_visual_shape: change a body visual shape by applying a loaded texture to it
step_simulation: step the PyBullet physics simulation forward one time step in a loop
